text:
anya: ok this is the last one from me today — marginally responsible plant owner confession. Margot found my fern, dug a tiny spa, and is now in a 30-second tub with a rubber duck. pic: https://i.imgur.com/abcd1234.jpg :frog: :duck:

dave: oh no. that is peak weekend energy. :laughing: also the duck is living its best life.

maria: where did you even get a duck that small?? it's perfect. :heart_eyes:

jules: is Margot auditioning for 'Plant Whisperer: The Musical' or 'Extreme Gardening, Pet Edition'? :thinking:

sam: rule 1 of houses with plants: leave them unattended for 3 minutes, and they become ponds. source: my cat. :sweat_smile:

anya: timeline: i left to make coffee, came back to soil on the floor and a very proud dog. posted a 2s boomerang too (margot_splish.gif)

dave: uploading that boomerang now. instant morale boost. :thumbsup: (reacts :heart:)

maria: quick poll — where does Margot belong on the team org chart?
1) Photoshoot & Branding
2) Horticulture & Soil Management

jules: vote: 2. she clearly has opinions about potting mix.

anya: lol she did a one-hole excavation and then assumed the role. duck is apparently the assistant manager.

sam: saving to the pet-photo calendar. caption ideas: 'fern-derella', 'margot: plant whisperer', 'soil you later'. thoughts?

dave: team favorite: 'fern-derella' :rofl:

maria: 'Margot: Plant Whisperer' gets my vote for the header on Friday drop :camera_with_flash:

anya: perfect — i'll add 'Margot: Plant Whisperer' to the Friday drop and credit the duck as assistant photographer. thanks y'all :party_parrot:
